---
title: Maths alt text
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
  html: default
filters:
  - typst-extras
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          if [ "$EXTENSION_TEST_FORMAT" = typst ]; then
            test "$(grep -o 'alt: "A"' "${EXTENSION_TEST_INPUT%.qmd}.typ" | wc -l)" -eq 1
          fi
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - - 'math\.equation\(block: false, alt: "x squared", \$x\^2\$\.body\)'
          - 'math\.equation\(block: true, alt: "Euler''s \\"identity\\" line", \$ e\^\(i pi\) \+ 1 = 0 \$\.body\)'
          - 'alt: "A"'
        - ['math\.equation\(block: (true|false), alt: "[^"]*", \[']
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['x\^2']
        - ['math\.equation', 'alt="x squared"', 'Euler']
---

Inline maths with alt text: [$x^2$]{alt="x squared"}.

::: {alt="Euler's \"identity\" line"}
$$ e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0 $$
:::

$$ a = b $$ {#eq-a alt="A"}

```{=typst}
#context {
  let equations = query(math.equation)
  assert.eq(equations.len(), 3, message: "expected one equation per source maths")
  assert.eq(equations.map(e => (e.alt, e.block)), (
    ("x squared", false),
    ("Euler's \"identity\" line", true),
    ("A", true),
  ))
}
```
